name: dentalprime
description: Plataforma brasileira de gestao para clinicas e redes odontologicas

scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @dentalprime/clinic-web && npm run build --workspace @dentalprime/admin-portal
scripts.typecheck:mobile: npm run typecheck --workspace @dentalprime/patient-mobile && npm run typecheck --workspace @dentalprime/professional-mobile
scripts.test:apps: npm test --workspace @dentalprime/clinic-web && npm test --workspace @dentalprime/admin-portal && npm run typecheck:mobile
scripts.bootstrap:development: docker compose --profile bootstrap up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from bootstrap bootstrap
scripts.smoke:backend: docker compose --profile smoke up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from smoke smoke
scripts.verify:development: npm run build && npm run build:web && npm run typecheck:mobile && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:apps && npm run typecheck --workspace @dentalprime/infrastructure && npm run synth --workspace @dentalprime/infrastructure -- --strict -c env=development -c account=111111111111 -c desiredCount=0
